facts.fact: Government spokesman Gerson Msigwa said that by August 2026 157 institutions, 72 public and 85 private, were linked to NIDA's registration and identification system, which lets them verify the people they serve.

TZA.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
Only cards produced (over 21 million, 1.5 million uncollected) are stated, not people enrolled.
The planned registration of people under 18 is not a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.

facts.fact: Government spokesman Gerson Msigwa said use of the national ID number has expanded to taxpayer registration, TASAF social services and business registration, among other services.
Government spokesman Gerson Msigwa named taxpayer registration, TASAF social services and business registration among services now using the national ID number.
Government spokesman Gerson Msigwa said more than 21 million national ID cards had been produced, over 1.5 million of them uncollected, from NIDA's registration and identification system.
